# Design Pricing

Pricing plan cards in 10 designs (classic, highlighted, glass, gradient header, minimal, horizontal, checklist, compact, dark enterprise, outline bold). Follows the common SaaS pricing-table pattern: plan, price with currency and period, short pitch, feature checklist and one call to action, with one plan highlighted.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_DESIGN_PRICING` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/designPricing` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column), report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.1 |

Use report mode with one row per plan (2 to 4 plans read best). Map Features to a column that joins the features with |, for example Unlimited orders|Priority support. Map Highlight to a column returning Y for the recommended plan. The call to action renders as a native Universal Theme button (hot for the highlighted plan).

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | Style | selectList (`classic`, `highlighted`, `glass`, `gradientHeader`, `minimal`, `horizontal`, `checklist`, `compact`, `darkEnterprise`, `outlineBold`) | yes | `classic` | The pricing design. Every style is a different layout or treatment; colors always come from the active theme style. |
| `plan` | Plan | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Plan name, for example Starter, Business or Enterprise. |
| `price` | Price | sessionStateValue | yes |  | The amount. Format it in SQL with the application's NLS settings, for example to_char(monthly_fee, 'FML999G990'). Text such as Custom also works. |
| `currency` | Currency | sessionStateValue |  |  | Currency symbol or code shown before the amount, for example SAR, USD or $. Leave empty for text prices such as Custom. |
| `period` | Period | sessionStateValue |  |  | Billing period shown after the amount, for example / month or per user / year. |
| `description` | Description | sessionStateValue |  |  | One short sentence about who the plan is for. |
| `features` | Features | sessionStateValue |  |  | Features separated by \|, for example 5 users\|Unlimited orders\|Email support. The runtime file turns them into a check list; without JavaScript the plain text is shown. |
| `ctaLabel` | Button Label | sessionStateValue |  |  | Call to action label, for example Start free trial or Contact sales. Leave empty to hide the button. |
| `ctaUrl` | Button Link | sessionStateValue |  |  | Target URL of the call to action, for example f?p=&APP_ID.:20:&SESSION.::NO::P20_PLAN:BUSINESS. Must be a developer-controlled value, never raw user input. Without a link a plain button is rendered for a Dynamic Action. |
| `badge` | Badge | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional short badge, for example Most popular or Save 20%. |
| `highlight` | Highlight | sessionStateValue |  |  | Y highlights this plan and makes its button the hot button. Any other value, or empty, renders a normal plan. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/design-pricing/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_design_pricing.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
